req.title: Retrieve all players
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players in the database.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET /players/ must return HTTP 200 and a JSON array of all Player objects. I designed tests covering: (1) EP positive — database pre-loaded with 26 rows, verify exact count, status code 200, Content-Type, and spot-check known field values from the fixture; (2) NEG negative — verify that an unsupported HTTP method (POST without body / wrong method) returns a non-200 or that a malformed path returns 404, and that the response body is a JSON array not an object; (3) BVA boundary — verify the exact count of 26 rows (boundary: neither 25 nor 27), verify each item has all required PlayerResponseModel fields (id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position), and verify the cache header is present. Additional tests cover: STC state-transition (cache MISS on first call, HIT on second), DT decision-table (verify specific known rows from fixture by squadNumber lookup within the array). All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_json_array

actions: Send GET /players/ with TestClient
expected: Response body is a JSON array
trace: R-PLAYER-001: system shall respond with HTTP 200 and JSON array of all players
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_json_array():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.headers['content-type']
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_each_item_has_required_fields():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    required_keys = {'id', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'squadNumber', 'position'}
    for item in body:
        for key in required_keys:
            assert key in item, f'Missing key {key} in item {item}'
        assert isinstance(item['id'], str)
        assert isinstance(item['firstName'], str)
        assert isinstance(item['lastName'], str)
        assert isinstance(item['squadNumber'], int)
        assert isinstance(item['position'], str)

tests.name: test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit_headers
preconditions: Cache is cold (first request after startup or cache cleared)
actions: Send first GET /players/ — expect X-Cache: MISS
Send second GET /players/ — expect X-Cache: HIT
Both responses must return 200 and same count
trace: R-PLAYER-001: caching state transition — MISS on cold cache, HIT on warm cache; both must return correct data
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from routes.player_route import simple_memory_cache, CACHE_KEY
import asyncio
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit_headers():
    asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(simple_memory_cache.clear(CACHE_KEY))
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.headers.get('x-cache') == 'MISS'
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert isinstance(body1, list)
    assert len(body1) == 26
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.headers.get('x-cache') == 'HIT'
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert isinstance(body2, list)
    assert len(body2) == 26

tests.name: test_get_all_players_squad_numbers_are_unique_and_complete
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows with squad numbers 1 through 26
actions: Send GET /players/
Extract all squadNumber values
Assert the set equals exactly {1, 2, ..., 26}
trace: R-PLAYER-001: all players — squad numbers must span 1..26 with no gaps or duplicates; catches count/range mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_squad_numbers_are_unique_and_complete():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    squad_numbers = [item['squadNumber'] for item in body]
    assert len(squad_numbers) == 26
    squad_set = set(squad_numbers)
    assert len(squad_set) == 26
    assert min(squad_set) == 1
    assert max(squad_set) == 26
    assert squad_set == set(range(1, 27))

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_all_players_starting11_boolean_values_correct():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    by_squad = {item['squadNumber']: item for item in body}
    p3 = by_squad[3]
    assert p3['starting11'] is True
    assert p3['starting11'] != False
    p1 = by_squad[1]
    assert p1['starting11'] is False
    assert p1['starting11'] != True
    p17 = by_squad[17]
    assert p17['starting11'] is True
    p2 = by_squad[2]
    assert p2['starting11'] is False
